description: Cross-language golden frames for HF Drive IPC 1.0. Both the Rust and the C# codecs MUST parse each golden fixture and reproduce payload bytes byte-for-byte from the typed model, and MUST reject each invalid fixture with the listed error code.

golden.name: hello_request
golden.description: hello request envelope at protocol 1.0

golden.name: hello_request_from_v2
golden.description: hello request from a future protocol version: normal parse must reject, handshake parse must accept

golden.name: hello_response_result
golden.description: hello result with provider capabilities

golden.name: get_status_request
golden.description: get_status request with empty body

golden.name: get_status_response_result
golden.description: get_status result carrying one full connection status (u64 decimal strings, nested objects, omitted optionals)

golden.name: get_status_response_error
golden.description: response error shape with retry hint

golden.name: start_login_response_oauth_client_not_configured
golden.description: OAuth configuration error uses the canonical cross-language wire spelling

golden.name: subscribe_status_request
golden.description: subscribe_status request with last_sequence

golden.name: status_changed_event
golden.description: status_changed event with a snapshot, one changed connection and one removal

golden.name: activity_changed_event
golden.description: activity_changed event batch

golden.name: conflicts_changed_event
golden.description: conflicts_changed event batch

golden.name: set_publication_credentials_request
golden.description: set_publication_credentials request; parsers must accept it and log helpers must never include the protected secret (marker: MARKER-PROTECTED-SECRET-DO-NOT-LOG)

golden.name: cancel_request_request
golden.description: cancel_request targeting another request id

golden.name: start_login_request_pkce
golden.description: start_login (pkce) with organization_id omitted

golden.name: start_login_request_device
golden.description: start_login (device) with organization_id present

golden.name: update_settings_request
golden.description: update_settings request with nested settings patch (nested optional omitted)

golden.name: preview_connect_request
golden.description: preview_connect request for a previously reserved binding

golden.name: begin_setup_request
golden.description: explicit initialization intent before credentials or root registration

golden.name: begin_setup_response_result
golden.description: reserved setup and connection with exact public DPAPI protection context

golden.name: list_activity_request
golden.description: list_activity read-only request scoped to one connection with a continuation cursor (no operation id)

golden.name: list_activity_response_result
golden.description: list_activity result page with nested activity record and next_cursor

golden.name: list_history_response_result
golden.description: list_history result with nested history changes

golden.name: connect_response_result
golden.description: connect result carrying the new connection status

golden.name: prepare_unlink_response_result
golden.description: prepare_unlink result with block counts and the provider-reviewed unlink preview

golden.name: prepare_unlink_response_result_remove_unavailable
golden.description: prepare_unlink result for the RemoveUnavailable mode: proceeding destroys online-only bytes and requires explicit affirmative consent; affected_files is producer-bounded at 200 entries

golden.name: unlink_request_remove_unavailable
golden.description: unlink request selecting RemoveUnavailable with the preview identity and explicit online-only data-loss consent (operation_id stays a fresh mutation id, never the preview id)

golden.name: list_owners_response_result
golden.description: list_owners result page with next_cursor

golden.name: exit_provider_request
golden.description: exit_provider request (mutation operation id)

golden.name: exit_provider_response_result
golden.description: exit_provider result

golden.name: probe_storage_response_result
golden.description: probe_storage result with per-check expectations and observations

golden.name: set_publication_credentials_response_result
golden.description: set_publication_credentials result (no secret material)

golden.name: repair_storage_request
golden.description: repair_storage request reusing one source setup reservation's verified publication credentials for an existing connected drive; no secret material travels on the wire

golden.name: repair_storage_response_result
golden.description: repair_storage result with the repaired connection status and the fresh probe/report identity (no secret material)

golden.name: import_request
golden.description: import request with the exact target object and raw bucket source paths (mutation operation id)

golden.name: import_response_result
golden.description: import result with the exact hfdrive-imports/<import_id> prefix (no trailing slash), per-file result records and full-width decimal u64 sizes/counts

golden.name: import_response_result_paged
golden.description: import result page carrying next_cursor: one page of per-file records with complete import_id/prefix/file_count/total_bytes repeated on every page

golden.name: import_request_files_cursor
golden.description: import request page continuation carrying files_cursor for the same operation (read replay, never a second mutation)
